landingHeroSubtitle: Play the classic social deduction game against intelligent AI characters with unique personas, rich backstories, and strategic thinking.
landingFeaturesSubtitle: Discover what makes Werewolf AI the ultimate social deduction experience
landingFeatureIntelligentAIDesc: Each AI agent has a unique personality, strategic thinking, and engaging dialogue capabilities powered by advanced language models.
landingFeatureMultilingualDesc: Play in over 25+ languages with automatic translation generation and full internationalization support.
landingFeatureDynamicDesc: AI agents create rich backstories and personalities that influence their behavior and decision-making throughout the game.
landingFeatureImmersiveDesc: High-quality text-to-speech with ElevenLabs integration brings characters to life with unique voices and personalities.
landingFeatureModernDesc: Beautiful, responsive interface built with cutting-edge web technologies for seamless gameplay across all devices.
landingFeaturePersistentDesc: Never lose your progress with full game state management that lets you save and resume games whenever you want.
landingAISubtitle: Powered by the latest AI models from leading providers
landingAIOpenAIDesc: Advanced reasoning and natural conversation with GPT-4 and GPT-3.5 models
landingAIClaudeDesc: Sophisticated strategic thinking and nuanced character development
landingAIGeminiDesc: Fast, efficient processing with Google's latest language model technology
landingAIGroqDesc: Ultra-fast inference for real-time gameplay and instant responses
landingHowItWorksSubtitle: Get started in minutes with our intuitive game flow
landingStep1Desc: Choose player count, AI models, game theme, and whether to join as a human player
landingStep2Desc: Watch as AI agents generate unique personas with names, backstories, and personalities
landingStep3Desc: Experience dynamic discussions, strategic voting, and thrilling night phases
landingStep4Desc: Discover who the werewolves were and enjoy the dramatic conclusion
landingTechSubtitle: Powered by the latest web technologies and AI innovations
landingCtaSubtitle: Join the next generation of social deduction gaming
landingRoleWerewolfDesc: Cunning predators who hunt under cover of darkness while maintaining their innocent facade during the day
landingRoleVillagerDesc: Brave townspeople using logic and deduction to identify and eliminate the werewolf threat
landingRoleSeerDesc: Mystical oracle who can peer into souls and discover the true nature of other players
landingRoleDoctorDesc: Heroic healer who can protect players from werewolf attacks with their medical expertise
landingFooterDescription: Experience the classic social deduction game like never before with intelligent AI characters.
